Well, there, I mean, it's going to go back a long ways. There are a number of things, you know, in the farm agricultural world. I've been on the Ag Committee for almost my whole time in Congress, both House and Senate. And so I've done, now I think we've done four farm bills. We do one about every five years or so. And, you know, so a lot of the agricultural policy that in South Dakota is, I think, hopefully meaningful to our farmers and ranchers. I've had a hand in developing over the years. And so, you know, that's our number one industry. So I'm proud of the work we've done there. And in the Commerce, Science, and Transportation space, and I did chair that committee for four years, I had to give it up to become the web. Our rules don't allow us to have both a chairman of a major committee and top two leadership positions. So I'm still the senior Republican on that committee, and so I'm very interested. But we did a lot of stuff in the tech space. We passed a bill a few years ago called Mobile Now, which expanded the amount of spectrum that's available for wireless use. And, you know, to accommodate 5G, you've got to have that. You've got to have spectrum. You've got to have infrastructure. And that bill did some of both. I mean, it helped to provide incentives for companies to build out the infrastructure that could carry the networks, accommodate the networks that would come and also creates additional spectrum, which you have to have. And I think as we have become increasingly dependent upon our wireless devices, that's gonna be really critical in the future. We did get a bill passed last year, and it was a Democrat, Ed Markey, one of the most liberal senators from Massachusetts and I, had a bill to ban robocalls. These annoying robocalls that you get, and I hope they've been cut down. For a while there, they were really out of hand, and we got a bill passed into law last year that gave the FCC the authority and the direction to dramatically decrease the amount of annoying nuisance calls people were getting.
